en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is Written in the Torah: “O son of Adam<sup>as</sup>! Remember me when you are angered, I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Remember you during My<sup>azwj</sup> Anger, so I<sup>azwj</sup> shall not Eliminate you among the ones I<sup>azwj</sup> do Eliminate;
and whenever you are oppressed with an injustice, so be pleased with My<sup>azwj</sup> Support for you, for My<sup>azwj</sup> Support for you is better than your support for yourself”’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Mahbub from Ishaq ibn ‘ Ammar who has said the following:
“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘It is written in the Torah: “Remember Me when you are angry so I remember you when I am angry and will not efface you along with those whom I will blot out.
When injustice is done to you, accept My support; My support for you is better than your support for yourself.’”
